edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the allowance owner key written by approve
msg.sender is used as spender for the allowance branch of transferFrom
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before delegatecall
init requires msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress
constructor assigns owner from msg.sender
transfer forwards all arguments to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from
transferFrom calls ensure as a precondition before mutating balances
ensure calls condition when the sender is not whitelisted
ensure derives the _UNI pair address via pairFor
ensure reads the canSale whitelist mapping for _from
ensure compares _from against tradeAddress, a whitelist bypass condition
ensure compares _from/_to against owner to skip condition checks
transferFrom reads and updates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to]
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each transfer
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value uses raw unchecked subtraction
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value use raw unchecked arithmetic
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum
condition enforces the _minSale lower bound
condition enforces the _maxSale upper bound
condition reads _saleNum to cap sales per address
init writes _minSale from token parameter
init writes _maxSale from maxToken parameter
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter
init scales bounds using decimals
batchSend performs unchecked multiplication and unchecked balance additions
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf for msg.sender and each recipient
delegate passes attacker-controlled address and bytes into delegatecall
delegatecall executes arbitrary external code that can reenter transferFrom and mutate balanceOf
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable
constructor sets owner to the deployer
constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument
constructor credits the full supply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router address
_value drives the unchecked subtraction and addition on allowances and balances in transferFrom
_value is multiplied by _tos.length without overflow protection in batchSend
_from is the address tested against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale in ensure
_to is compared against owner inside ensure to bypass condition checks
_spender is the spender key written in allowance by approve
_tos is iterated to distribute balances in batchSend
parameter a is the delegatecall target address
parameter b is the delegatecall calldata
addr becomes the new whitelisted tradeAddress
saleNum parameter is assigned to _saleNum in init
local index i controls the batchSend loop iteration
local _to holds the current recipient used for balanceOf updates and Transfer events

normalization_plan.reason: _value is a transient amount argument fully consumed by transferFrom arithmetic and has no independent semantic identity
_from is only used for whitelist comparison inside ensure and can be folded into the gate function
_to is only used for the owner comparison inside ensure and carries no independent state
_spender is a transient key argument of approve already captured by the allowance state variable
_tos is the transient recipient array iterated by batchSend and disappears after the loop
a is the immediately consumed target address of the unsafe delegatecall operation
b is the immediately consumed calldata of the unsafe delegatecall operation
addr is a transient argument stored directly into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
saleNum is immediately assigned to the _saleNum state variable inside init
local loop counter i exists only for the duration of the batchSend loop
local _to exists only within one batchSend iteration to address a recipient balance update
